# Protected fork files for upstream-sync (nukeop/nuclear).
# Format: <policy> <path-prefix-or-file>
#
# Policies:
#   keep-ours       Upstream changes to these files must NEVER be merged automatically;
#                   any upstream diff immediately blocks the sync and requires manual review.
#   review-required Upstream changes that merge cleanly force the PR into DRAFT mode
#                   with a prominent warning listing the modified fork files.

# --- Strictly fork-owned files (never accept upstream edits silently) ---
keep-ours packages/player/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
keep-ours packages/player/src-tauri/src/ytdlp.rs
keep-ours packages/player/src/stores/updaterStore.ts

keep-ours README.md
keep-ours scripts/verify-fork-integrity.mjs
keep-ours scripts/build-local-appimage.sh
keep-ours scripts/build-local-windows.sh
keep-ours .husky/pre-commit
keep-ours .gitattributes
keep-ours .github/fork-protected-files.txt
keep-ours .github/workflows/multiplatform-release.yml
keep-ours .github/workflows/upstream-sync.yml
keep-ours .github/workflows/fork-verify.yml

# --- Critical shared files containing fork features / platform fixes ---
